hall-day.note: hall-day.jpg, the 1928 tower from the south-east. White stone above the tree line. The base is in the trees and is not in this mask. A neighbouring tower on the right is excluded.

hall-dusk.note: hall-silhouette.png, dusk profile of the shaft and the stepped crown. The foreground roof starts near y=729 and is cut off, along with the person and the railing. The base of the tower is not in this still.

hall-plan.note: OpenStreetMap relation 6333145, the surveyed footprint of Los Angeles City Hall (outer way 425993492). Rotated onto its long axis. This is not the mesh source boxes.

lapd-aerial.note: lapd-roof.jpg, the film overhead of the LAPD tower. The two lamps are a spinner and are not the roof. The mask is the brighter tower under them. The frame is an oblique aerial, not an orthographic plan. No cleaner published plan of this roof was in the reference set.

lapd-plan.note: Roof deck traced from lapd-roof.jpg, the film overhead. The two lamps are a spinner and are not the roof. The shaft face under the deck is not in this mask. This is not the mesh source boxes.

wallace-face.note: wallace-bts.jpg, the Weta miniature, left pyramid only. The still is a low oblique of one face, cropped through the base. It is not a top view. No verified overhead of the Wallace pyramids was found in the Weta workshop notes or the published stills searched for this pass.

wallace-plan.note: Square plan of the Weta Wallace pyramid. wallace-bts.jpg shows two equal faces of the centre tower meeting at a corner, and one face of the same pyramid beside it. No nadir photograph was found. This outline is that square plan, not the terrace boxes the mesh was built from.
